newsitem.title: FRANCE: Credit National sees profit for 1996.
newsitem.headline: Credit National sees profit for 1996.

text.p: French bank Credit National aims to make a profit for the full-year 1996, chairman Emmanuel Rodocanachi said on Wednesday.

"It is clear that the second half will be better in view of the exceptional elements in the first half," he told a news conference. "The objective for 1996 is of course to get past the breakeven barrier."
Credit National earlier reported a first half net attributable loss of 112 million francs, which included the 250 million franc restructuring costs following its merger with BFCE bank.
It posted a proforma 1995 profit of 267 million francs.
